title: 3 Ways to Profit from the Rise of Cryptocurrency (Without Actually Buying It) -
text:
Dan Cryptocurrency: The Trend You Can’t Ignore
We are now in 2018. Everyone including your mother has heard of Bitcoin by now, right? As I type this, the total cryptocurrency market cap is $309 Billion USD! That is a LOT of money tied up in these virtual assets.
You have also heard of the so called “bitcoin millionaires” that accumulated fortunes by hoarding the digital currency back when it was still new. You might have thought of getting involved by buying some cryptocurrency for yourself. Maybe your FOMO is kicking in (which is a bad reason to invest, BTW). Unfortunately, crypto is not that easy to get into, even more-so for those who aren’t the greatest with technology.
Luckily, if you have a good feeling about this growing trend, there are other (less volatile) ways to gain some exposure to it! Aggressive investors may gladly welcome this high potential for growth that crypto brings! Check out these 3 ways you can use the stock market to profit from cryptocurrency: 1) Semiconductor Stocks
Semiconductor companies sure have been loving the rise of cryptocurrency! The reason is simple: the GPUs (Graphic Processing Units) that they create are used to “mine” cryptocurrency. I’m sure by now you’ve heard of people who got rich from mining Bitcoin. Basically, this “mining” involves using your computer to perform complex math in order to validate other people’s transactions so they can be added to the blockchain (virtual ledger); the system then rewards you with some Bitcoin of your own! Bitcoin is finite like gold, there will only ever be 21 million bitcoin! Since the process I described above is the only way to get new Bitcoin, it is called “mining”. (Did I sound like I was speaking another language? Long story short: Maintaining the bitcoin network is a group effort, if you have a powerful computer you can contribute to the network and get rewarded with bitcoin ). Which Companies Benefit? Pictured above is the Nvidia GeForce GTX 1070. This bad boy is currently one of the most popular pieces of hardware for crypto mining!
So, back to semiconductor companies. Crypto mining has contributed to an increasingly large part of their income as people buy up their products to create powerful custom computers known as “mining rigs”. Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA ) and AMD (NYSE: AMD ) are by far the 2 most popular GPU makers for cryptocurrency miners. They are used to mine a variety of coins, not just Bitcoin. Nvidia has said in their latest earnings report (May 2018) that cryptocurrency mining accounted for $289 million USD in revenue! Even Nvidia themselves are skeptical and project this revenue to fall, but luckily there is much more to semiconductor companies than crypto.
Obviously, these companies directly benefit from the surge in crypto mining. But, these companies won’t be filing for chapter 11 bankruptcy if cryptocurrency goes sour; it is but a small portion of the companies billion dollar revenues! Many other potential uses for Nvidia’s and AMD’s computer chips’ include video games, artificial intelligence, machine learning, self driving vehicles, and more. 2) Cryptocurrency Mining Stocks
Remember all this chit-chat about mining cryptocurrency? Well, there happen to be a handful of publicly traded companies that are in the business of mining coins! This is obviously the riskiest of the investing ideas mentioned in this article. These companies are solely in business just for crypto! They are also super volatile; perhaps consider locking in your profit if you strike gold from one of these stocks! Canada Based
One business that has been gathering alot of attention is HIVE Blockchain Technologies (TSXV: HIVE ). The Canada based company has datacentres that mine Ethereum (the 2nd biggest cryptocurrency in the world behind Bitcoin). Their datacentres are in 3 countries: Iceland, Sweden, and Norway. Can you figure out what these 3 countries have in common?
They are cold . Cold as hell. Iceland looks like it gets cold… Beautiful place to mine some crypto!
The long story short is this: the massive computers generate heat, and need cooling. Being in a cold climate means using less cooling… maybe they just leave the doors open, I’m not too sure. Using less cooling means spending less money on cooling, which lowers their operating costs. You don’t need to be a business major to conclude that lower operating costs = larger profit margins! This is the competitive advantage that HIVE claims to have.
There are other companies in this business you can look into. Atlas Cloud Enterprises (CSE: AKE ) is another Canadian headquartered company that is in the business of crypto mining. These guys have a datacentre in Washington State that mines Bitcoin. Atlas boasts that they pay some of the cheapest electricity prices in the world since they happen to be down the street from the largest power plant in the USA. USA Based
RIOT Blockchain (NASDAQ: RIOT ) is another groundbreaking company trying to ride this blockchain wave. RIOT sees the big picture and knows there is more to cryptocurrency than just mining it. That’s why they own a 13% stake of Coinsquare , one of the largest cryptocurrency exchanges in Canada!
They also mine bitcoin too of course: Their latest earnings report states a revenue of $900,000 from January- March, 2018. Their website claims they mined 122 BTC in May 2018, which is worth over $940000 alone (at least at today’s rate: $7720 USD). Beating the previous quarter’s revenue in just one month, now that sure is some aggressive growth!
DISCLAIMER = These companies (or others that mainly revolve around cryptocurrency) are speculative in nature. Also, the lack of accounting standards with respect to digital assets (ie. crypto) make evaluating these companies’ financial statements even more difficult. Please: research, research, and research! 3) Companies Investing in Blockchain
Blockchain and cryptocurrency are not the same thing! Blockchain is the technology that makes crypto work… crypto also happens to be the biggest application of blockchain that we’ve seen. I won’t get into too much detail on blockchain in this post, but you can check out this cool little graphic on it below, courtesy of IBM:
Many innovative corporations are paying attention to blockchain tech and cryptocurrency; it has grown far too large to just ignore. These companies come from all sectors: tech, finance, healthcare, and more. One can say companies that embrace this disruptive technology are likely to be in a better position than their peers down the road!
These examples are obviously more of a bet on blockchain itself than crypto, but it is by far the safest bet (relatively). Many of these examples are pilot projects, they wont be drastically improving the company this month, this quarter, or even this year. Obviously they are setting themselves up to take advantage of this tech in the long run. Overall, I view this as a very indirect method to profit from blockchain/cryptocurrency.
Without further ado, here are some prominent examples of companies betting big on this tech! Finance
Goldman Sachs (NYSE: GS) , America’s 5th largest bank, is making some bold moves in 2018 when it comes to cryptocurrency. First, they have said they will facilitate the trading of Bitcoin futures , which is huge considering no other major investment bank does that. Secondly, they plan on backing a cryptocurrency of their own based on the US dollar. It will work like any other crypto based on blockchain technology, BUT it will be tied to the US dollar in an effort to get rid of these crazy price swings. This idea is the brainchild of the GS-backed startup known as Circle . Very bold move, but it can pay off large if the idea catches on! Logistics Warren Buffet has made it clear he is NOT a fan of cryptocurrency. His businesses have benefited from blockchain though!
Warren Buffet, CEO of Berkshire Hathaway (NYSE: BRK-A) is one of the most vocal critics of Cryptocurrency. Funny enough though, his conglomerate is starting to benefit from it! BNSF Railway (owned by Berkshire) has joined a partnership with other transportation companies such as Fedex (NYSE: FDX ) , and UPS (NYSE: UPS ). This partnership is focused on using blockchain technology to completely streamline things like supply chains and logistics. Eliminating inefficiencies = larger profit margins ! Technology
IBM (NYSE: IBM ) is probably the biggest name in blockchain tech right now. They are heavily investing in providing blockchain solutions for customers. One such example is how they’re partnering with Wal-Mart (NYSE: WMT ) in a pilot project to improve food quality. The blockchain would enable tracking packages of food from the farm to the grocery store shelves. Wal-Mart is also hungry for blockchain powered solutions; it is no secret they have an insanely complex supply chain and are looking to cut inefficiencies wherever they can!
Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT ) also plans on being a blockchain solutions provider with their Azure services. They want to work with other companies to develop blockchain solutions that work for them, much like IBM. They are open about this, unlike Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) who have been VERY secretive regarding their significant blockchain research. We only know about it through Patents Apple has filed. Payment Systems
It’s no secret, cryptocurrency poses a huge potential threat to traditional banks and payment system providers (credit cards, Paypal, etc.). Mastercard (NYSE: MA ) has taken some steps to keep itself ahead however! They are using blockchain to improve the privacy and security of their transactions greatly. Mastercard’s blockchain tech is currently opened up for development in B2B (business to business) transactions only. However, it is an interesting spin on the cryptocurrency idea! It essentially uses the power of blockchain, but uses normal currency instead of crypto. Summing It Up
I hope you got an idea of how big the whole cryptocurrency and blockchain thing really is! If it peaked your interest, you now have learned about 3 potential ways to get in on the action without actually buying the coins themselves. This is a great thing because different level of exposure means different levels of risk; there is an option for you no matter what your investment style is ! If you found this article helpful, don’t forget to share it with your friends. Also, signing up for our email list would mean you’re going to be the first to know all the best financial tips and tricks for your early 20’s! You don’t want to go through FOMO, do you?
